name: Posadas (Spain)
description: Vertically divided, the hoist half blue with the crowned municipal arms of Posadas (a tower on white and the four bars) and the fly half with four red bars on yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Posadas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Posadas arms — tower and the four bars
four red bars on yellow at the fly
